records.title: What's new in CN1: latest news, updates and progress
records.body: Latest news / what's new / quoi de neuf / nouvelles / nouveautes / novidades: the November 23 review records real progress since the November 6 archive. The dice tower is physically assembled and its fit with the tray is owner-validated. NEX-01 has ongoing multicolor print and early electronics work, plus an approved Wi-Fi desk-companion architecture. Two original dice designs are approved and a sculptural D20 study exists; its print and play validation remain unfinished. Modular electronics holders have CAD prototype files; a painting grip has owner-tested ergonomics. CN1 passed an image-recognition test in Telegram on November 22; this is not a claim about NEX's image capabilities. The Black Lab's 3D start and Seed X-Ray were owner-validated. The future Guild Hall has an isolated layout preview and a colossal-tree direction, with the elevator inside the trunk. These are concrete tests, prototypes and design milestones, not a claim that every project has launched. The latest documented work is available even without a new public game release.

records.title: NEX-01 connected desk figurine and miniature laboratory
records.body: NEX-01 is the physical connected desk figurine and miniature lab, distinct from the Telegram bot. The owner has begun hands-on multicolor printing and early electronics work; current modelling checks concern clean colour separation, tongue/tooth details, assembly and the replacement torso screen. The November 22 architecture decision makes it a Wi-Fi companion linked to our own NEX service, handling sound, display, presence and lighting on the device. The selected screen is now the Waveshare 1.83-inch model, replacing the unavailable round display. NEX itself stays fixed; servos are intended for the scanner/accessories. The architecture is approved, but working voice firmware, screen integration and a link with Telegram still need to be built and tested. No finished product or sale date is announced.

records.title: CN1 La Poigne du Neant dice tower
records.body: The physical La Poigne du Neant dice tower has reached an owner-validated assembly milestone: the tower is mounted and its connection to the tray fits correctly. At the latest owner report reviewed on November 23, the slide was still being printed, remaining supports were being finalized and decorative work was the next stage. Sound, lighting and a possible impact-triggered effect are part of the electronics preparation, not yet a demonstrated working installation. This is a substantial physical prototype, with the complete dice path, finishing and electronics still to validate.

records.title: CN1 original tabletop dice and sculptural D20
records.body: Two original dice art directions are approved: Eclat comprime (compressed mineral forms) and Rosace repliee (folded rose-window architecture), designed to fit the tower's universe. The November 20 checkpoint includes an actual sculptural D20 model and a render made from that geometry, with thick faceted shapes and recessed numbers. Its resting surfaces still need correction; the study is not yet ready to print or play. Physical print tests, painting, roll behaviour, resin masters and moulds remain later steps. The earlier panelled D6 is not the current approved sculptural direction. This is active prototype development, not a finished or commercially validated dice range.

records.title: CN1 LAB LINK modular electronics workbench
records.body: CN1 LAB LINK now has a first modular electronics-workbench design, documented November 22. CAD and prototype files are prepared for mechanically connected printed holders for breadboards, small controller boards, terminal blocks and cables, plus practical soldering-wire supports. The purpose is to make NEX-01 and future hardware prototyping easier with reusable modules. Digital geometry checks have been performed; physical fit tests with the printer and real components are still required. This is a prototype toolset, not a finished tested product or an electrical connection through the printed joints.

records.title: CN1 painting grip and workshop tools
records.body: The workshop's painting grip has progressed through real owner feedback: the handle's ergonomics, textures and base were approved. The adjustment wheel is being made more substantial, and the adjustable little-finger rest and support rods are being refined for comfortable use and strength. A fragile printed part prompted a redesign request. These are tested elements within an evolving workshop accessory; the entire final assembly is not being presented as finished. This work supports painting the project's physical miniatures and tabletop creations.

records.title: CN1 Eggplant Queen voxel trophy
records.body: The owner approved the voxel-style Eggplant Queen trophy concept in November. The intended design combines the eggplant sculpture and a broad stable base in one multicolour print, with volume and pixel-like relief on both sides. A separate nameplate is planned for the base so it can be changed without replacing the sculpture. The approved concept is real design progress; a successful final print, production run or public sale has not been established.

records.title: CN1 Telegram image recognition test
records.body: On November 22 the owner tested whether CN1 could recognize an image in Telegram and explicitly reported that the test succeeded. This is a confirmed owner-reported image-understanding milestone for CN1 in Telegram. It does not establish that every group message is analyzed, that all image types work or that the separate @CN1Nex_bot now has image recognition. Broader availability and integration still need their own evidence.

records.title: CN1 Tree of the Abyss and future Guild Hall
records.body: On November 23 the Guild Hall reached architectural prototyping: an isolated layout preview exists, and the owner approved a more monumental hall dominated by a colossal Tree of the Abyss. The future Underworld elevator belongs inside the trunk/root base, with a separate route to MUTANT's Black Lab. The aim is a shared CN1 social room eventually accessible from the Club and a dedicated entry page, without requiring completion of Demon Drift. Detailed 3D scenery, lighting, subtle animation and performance work will follow in stages. The new hall is not deployed or publicly open at this checkpoint; the marketplace, Underworld travel and item economy are future systems.

records.title: CN1 tabletop RPG and shared universe
records.body: The current creative direction is to connect physical miniatures, original dice and dice towers with the existing CN1 world, Club and Black Lab. The giant Tree of the Abyss and future Guild Hall provide a setting for that connection. Work is focused on a coherent universe and practical tabletop creations while preserving the games already built. A finished tabletop rules system, complete campaign, live physical-to-game rewards and public shop catalogue are not established. This is an approved direction being developed, with no announced launch date.

records.title: CN1 MUTANT and The Lab
records.body: The owner verified that The Black Lab loads correctly in Edge and that the Seed's X-RAY interaction works. The earlier calibration-screen startup problem was resolved in the November 6 checkpoint; do not report it as a current blocker. The reactor has the approved fitted purple egg, clearer glass, subtle bubbles and cleaned-up surface details. X-RAY is a spectral view of the egg's surface; an internal creature and shared biological evolution remain future work. The G03-G05 local experiment loop produced a stable report, and a real Black Box Telegram share was confirmed on November 7 with the correct /black-lab/ link. These are local practice experiments, not live guild inventory or global Seed changes. The official public entrance remains mutant.eggplantqueen.lol, with the lab at mutant.eggplantqueen.lol/black-lab/.

records.title: NEX assistant and how to ask
records.body: NEX is CN1's separate laboratory scientist and project guide, using dated approved public records. Community explanations should be clear, natural English or Brazilian Portuguese, with prototype progress distinguished from public releases. The owner's Portuguese visitor-welcome test was successful. The latest archive now covers the connected NEX-01 figurine, workshop, dice tower, tabletop dice, Guild Hall and community tests as well as the games and Black Lab. NEX-01 is a separate physical prototype: its Wi-Fi conversation architecture is approved, but working voice firmware and a Telegram connection are not yet demonstrated. Ask about the figurine to distinguish it from this bot. NEX can describe approved progress; he does not operate the real laboratory, grant game rewards or automatically publish community announcements.

records.title: CN1 the CLUB
records.body: The CLUB is an owner-reported live and evolving 3D social/music space, according to the public CN1 status of 2026-09-29. Avatars, game-room activity and social features continue to evolve. This does not confirm that every arcade station, multiplayer feature, roulette variant or reward is publicly accessible in every build.

records.title: CN1 Demon Drift
records.body: Chapter I was owner-reported publicly released by October 31. At the November 10 checkpoint, Chapter II's eight-direction movement update was recorded as installed, with movement, dash, combat, smoke, Seed, Warden, Webheart and cinematic checks reported successful. This is an owner-reported development milestone, not a new certification of public access to every chapter. The unfinished Chapter III is on hold; a documented transition concept would connect its story to the Tree of the Abyss, the future Guild Hall and MUTANT. The new transition, Underworlds and shared inventory remain future work. Check the official Arcade for currently offered playable access.

records.title: CN1 BAD DECISIONS
records.body: The owner has tested Room 1 combat updates and experiments for later areas including Liquidity Mall and a DOOM-like room. Loot, Scrap, crafting and equipment upgrades are under development; do not assume planned trading, shared XP or every prototype room is live.

records.title: Lower Rooms
records.body: Owner-reported private technical tests included room create/join, human 1v1 combat, avatars, damage, kills, respawn and combat effects. Broader multiplayer work continues. Full public 2v2 availability is not verified by this checkpoint.

records.title: CN1 guilds
records.body: The existing guild work includes an owner-reported limited private beta and read-only NFT-related functions. New progress on November 23 concerns the future Guild Hall: an isolated architectural preview and an approved direction for a colossal Tree of the Abyss, with a future Underworld elevator inside its trunk and a separate route to MUTANT. The intended hall is one shared meeting place, eventually reachable from the Club and its own entry page without requiring players to finish Demon Drift. The hall is not publicly opened by this checkpoint. Its marketplace, item transfers, world transitions and new rewards still need implementation and validation.

records.title: CN1 DJ Lab
records.body: The owner tested a multi-minute mixing timeline and work on easier sound selection, audio handling and interface design. This remains an experimental workstream; the exact deployed build, audio quality and public access need a separate current check.

records.title: CN1 Comics and Sunday stories
records.body: The recurring CN1 Sunday comic series continues to connect the characters, games and community. Recent creative work includes Demon Drift story ideas and an episode direction about learning 3D printing and starting the NEX desk-figurine electronics project. Those themes are work in progress, not proof that a particular new episode has already been published. Artwork and announcements remain creator-reviewed and manually shared. Do not invent episode numbers, publication counts or release dates.

records.title: CN1 website
records.body: The owner reports the official CN1 public website at eggplantqueen.lol is online and that its MUTANT card correctly opens the MUTANT homepage, mutant.eggplantqueen.lol. From that homepage, visitors can enter the separately branded The Black Lab laboratory. The public MUTANT titles/labels were cleaned up in the Nov 6 owner-verified checkpoint; an old Telegram link preview may remain cached. Other CN1 website areas include dedicated Shop and Community Arcade presentation work, but this record is not proof of a live checkout, open community ballots or a fully completed catalogue. Do not claim the old November 3 'homepage still pending publication' status is current.

records.title: CN1 Raid Bot
records.body: CN1's existing Telegram Raid Bot supports optional community missions around selected X posts. Administrators can configure mission duration and limits; optional participation and reward rules belong to the CN1 Raid system, not NEX. A manual completion signal must not be described as independently verified X likes or replies. The Raid Bot is separate from NEX X Radar. A future integration might be explored, but none is confirmed live. No pressure, spam or copy-paste campaigns are supported.

records.title: CN1 X Radar
records.body: Owner-reported November 4: NEX X Radar is installed and tested as an owner-controlled Telegram pilot. A curated X conversation can be previewed with clear human approval or dismissal; the public post link is not released to the group until the owner authorizes it. Participation is optional and meant for original discussion, not raids or guaranteed interaction. This pilot does not automatically search all of X, post replies or award XP; a production integration with the separate Raid Bot remains future work.

records.title: CN1 X discovery and post watch
records.body: CN1 is using a human-curated process to identify relevant X discussions about Solana, memecoins, Web3 gaming, Telegram community tooling and related culture. Suggestions are reviewed before community sharing or publishing; NEX X Radar currently uses owner-selected links, not an always-on automated X discovery source. A direct automated watch-to-NEX integration is in development and may require licensed data access or an X API with limits and costs. It is not an included live paid-API product, and no automatic engagement or mass tagging is provided.

records.title: CN1 MUTANT 3D machines and lab effects
records.body: The November 7 owner checkpoints record further accepted Black Lab atmosphere and layout improvements: an industrial ceiling, controlled coloured vapor from laboratory equipment and overhead exhausts, clearer placement of the right-side machines, the biotech pod back on its island and decorative laboratory specimens on rear shelving. The reactor, Relay scanner, Distiller, Chiller, Black Box and containment hardware form an evolving 3D lab. Physical controls and fluid animation are being developed progressively, machine by machine. The reactor's thermal instrument concerns the local experiment's heat index, not a verified biological temperature of the shared Seed. Use original CN1 model and machine names in public explanations, without internal release labels or modelling-tool names.
